chunks: "Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than tawaf, and tawaf, and tawaf—until he counted ten times."

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer; a person of faith
key_terms.طَوَافٍ: circumambulation around the Ka'bah as an act of worship

ai.seo_question: Is fulfilling the need of a believer better than performing tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great virtue of fulfilling a believer’s need and placing service to others among the highest acts of devotion. It emphasizes that helping a mu'min can surpass even repeated acts of worship such as tawaf in spiritual merit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2159 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than performing Tawaf, and Tawaf, and Tawaf—up to ten times."
